name: mender
description: Mr. Fix-it: works out what happened to a sick or offline machine, finds the root cause, and gets it back up, carefully, reversibly, and with a report of what it did.

target.about: the machine to mend: 'local' (this one), or 'user@host' over ssh (for a box too broken to run an agent, or offline)

symptom.about: what you've noticed, if anything: 'site is down', 'can't ssh in', 'disk full alerts' (blank: it looks for itself)
